data.rationale: The proposal follows the true procedure in the same order (Time Zone Converter, two cities, holidays for a country, a Sync email to ops with the offset and holiday dates, then Discard) and names the right parameters; it loses a little on feasibility because it hardcodes "hours ahead", leaves the recipient and the Send/Discard step ambiguous, and doesn't make the Mail tab switch explicit.
